fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied no street address (Indeed locations list) and city-centroid coords (35.1465, -90.1842), ~7km off. Resolved to 3271 Infinity Parkway, West Memphis AR 72301 - the documented CJ Logistics America (legacy DSC Logistics) West Memphis DC (Yahoo Local, Indeed). Geocoded ROOFTOP to 35.1869, -90.2472; satellite confirmed a large cross-dock DC in open farmland.
fieldNotes.truckGate: z20-z21 satellite shows a controlled truck gate on the south side: a guard booth, gate spanning the lane (sliding/swing), and chain-link perimeter fencing. A semi-truck is visible at the gate. 2013 Street View confirms continuous chain-link perimeter fencing around the property. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small tan booth structure sits beside the gate at the south truck entrance, with vehicles/truck present - a staffed guard shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock building with trailers backed into dock doors along BOTH long faces (north and south). ~70 doors estimated (50+ band). Approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Deep truck courts on the north and south faces with ~60 trailers visible, including trailer storage rows in the north court. dropArea 25-50, dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on opposing north and south building faces form physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate set well back from any public road, reached by an access road (Infinity Parkway) winding through farmland, with deep truck courts -> holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Building sits in open farmland off Infinity Parkway, edge of West Memphis -> Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is in open farmland but within the West Memphis logistics/intermodal area; cellular coverage likely adequate - left false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
